trigger: The frozen-backbone selection study has not produced a candidate passing every quality gate. Test whether a bounded decision-training intervention closes that gap before making a v4 recommendation.
candidate_rule: Two highest development macro-accuracy product-license-eligible candidates after primary compatibility fixes; freeze their IDs in a nomination before adapter training

training.sampling: Round-robin equal task exposure; deterministic shuffled cycles of training rows only
training.target_modules: Language-backbone q_proj and v_proj (or fused qkv_proj) Linear layers only. Freeze all existing weights. New adapter parameters use float32; backbone uses BF16.
training.loss: Cross entropy over supplied single-token candidate codes, with all other vocabulary entries excluded
training.checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-step adapter only; no early stopping or development-guided checkpoint selection
training.merge: Merge the low-rank update into the base Linear weights before extracting evaluation features; preserve the original publisher checkpoint in cache

readout_and_calibration: Repeat the same frozen-feature readout grid and independent calibration protocol on the adapted backbone. All final selection uses development only.
budget: Inside the existing $250 and 24-GPU-job study ceiling; no persistent endpoint
data_rights: Research only. SLURP audio has a CC BY-NC license; these adapters cannot be silently promoted into a commercial product.
limitations: This small task-specific training set does not establish broad intelligence
Candidate shortlist is chosen on development results, not randomly
Public benchmark pretraining contamination remains unknown
Unchanged primary quality gates; do not lower floors after seeing failures
